help.title: Help
help.step1: Open “Templates” and load one, or type the activities into the schedule.
help.step2: Press “Open projection”, drag the window to the whiteboard and double-click it for full screen. With a single screen, use “Class mode”.
help.step3: Press “Start” and move on with the right arrow or a presentation remote.
help.step4: Everything can be edited live: the projection updates instantly.
help.shortcutsHelp: They work in the panel, in class mode and in the projection window. Presentation remotes are supported.
help.aboutText: TEApp helps structure the session in a visual, predictable way on the interactive whiteboard. It is designed especially for autistic students, but applies to the whole group (Universal Design for Learning): it never singles anyone out.
help.privacy: No accounts and no server. Data is stored only in this browser and the app works offline.
